task.description:
Draft a new requirement section for Stage F7 - Tenant Onboarding GUI.

CONTEXT:
The platform backend already has a complete tenant onboarding API:
  POST /api/v1/onboarding - creates tenant, Keycloak realm, admin user, OIDC client, hostname binding atomically.
  GET  /api/v1/onboarding/:id - poll saga status (fresh | in_progress | completed | failed).
  GET  /api/v1/onboarding?hostname=<h> - look up tenant by hostname.

There is currently NO GUI for this. A PLATFORM_ADMIN (System Business Owner) cannot register a new
tenant through the browser. They must use a raw API call.

GOAL:
Specify a GUI screen (or wizard) in the existing React admin section that allows a PLATFORM_ADMIN to:
1. Fill in company details (slug, display name, admin email, admin username, admin display name, hostname, redirect URIs)
2. Submit the onboarding request
3. See real-time progress while the saga runs
4. See the final result (success or failure with reason)

REQUIREMENT IDs to draft (Stage F7, prefix ONB-UI):
  ONB-UI-01 - Onboarding entry point: a 'Register Tenant' action visible only to PLATFORM_ADMIN in the admin nav.
  ONB-UI-02 - Registration form: fields, validation rules, submit action. Maps to POST /api/v1/onboarding body.
  ONB-UI-03 - Progress tracking: poll GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id and display saga step status to the user.
  ONB-UI-04 - Result screen: success (show tenant slug + realm URL) or failure (show error reason, allow retry).

EXISTING FRONTEND CONVENTIONS:
- All admin pages are in web/src/pages/admin/
- API calls go through web/src/api/client.ts
- Role-based UI: hidden (not disabled) for non-PLATFORM_ADMIN users
- No TENANT_ADMIN role exists yet; all admin operations run as PLATFORM_ADMIN
- Highest implemented frontend stage is F6 (WH-UI-04 released 2026-05-31)

FORMAT:
Add the four requirements after the last requirement in the requirements doc (after WH-UI-04 section).
Use the exact same format as nearby requirements (### ID - Title [MUST], acceptance criteria, See: references).
Each requirement must include:
  - Priority: MUST
  - Stage: F7
  - Acceptance criteria written as GIVEN/THEN scenarios
  - See: references to OIDC-17 (idempotency), OIDC-18 (transactional), the backend onboarding endpoints
  - Role guard: only PLATFORM_ADMIN can access

Do NOT specify implementation details (component names, React hooks, TypeScript types).
Specify BEHAVIOUR and ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA only.

Also add a new ## Stage F7 - Tenant Onboarding GUI heading before the requirements if one does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: ONB-UI-01 through ONB-UI-04 are written in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md under a new ## Stage F7 heading
Each requirement has priority MUST, stage F7, GIVEN/THEN acceptance criteria
Requirements reference the existing backend API endpoints
Role guard (PLATFORM_ADMIN only) is specified in each requirement
No implementation code is present in the requirement text

result.summary: Drafted ONB-UI-01 through ONB-UI-04 in Stage F7 section of requirements doc
